nativeSources.role: Native style guidance avoids heading links and places related links at the beginning of the section.
Native Artigo principal receives the supplied target in its first positional argument.

automaticBoundary: One complete literal heading link, nonempty section body, no existing unrelated remission, confirmed main-namespace non-disambiguation target, target not the current article. The production task binds the result to the exact source and rejects draft changes during the query.
meaning: Conditional lookup is implemented automatic functionality with a required read-only proof. It does not infer arbitrary destinations or promise parity with every predecessor regular expression.
